name: Dina
description: Dina is a tea-brewing dryad of Strixhaven's Witherbloom college, the sole survivor of a glade destroyed by the Brittleblight, who later became a teaching assistant and grad student.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

summary.text: Dina is a tea-brewing dryad of Strixhaven's Witherbloom college, the sole survivor of a glade destroyed by the Brittleblight, who later became a teaching assistant and grad student.

bio.text: Dina, rescued by Lisette from her dying glade, secretly attempted a forbidden ritual from a chained tome, and her corrupted ritual birthed a bog creature.

citations.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.
"The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

bio.text: With Killian she fought the creature, using a balancing spell at great cost to herself, and she woke in the infirmary after Killian dragged her there.

citations.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.
"The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

bio.text: Valentin let her stay at Strixhaven as a place of second chances.

citations.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

bio.text: During the Phyrexian invasion she and Zimone built the ritual that blasted a hole through the Biblioplex.

bio.text: As a teaching assistant she led a sample-collection trip to the Harrier's Wood, reported four students missing, and led Liliana and Ajani to search for them.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

bio.text: She helped her friend Zimone see herself kindly and trace the duplicated Multiverse to Chandra Nalaar, and offered her a place to stay.

bio.text: As a grad student she led a field trip to capture the Devotion, telling her students about the Brittleblight and asking them to build a web together.

status.text: As of the latest story Dina is alive, a Witherbloom grad student who has survived the Brittleblight alone and later failed to restore her glade.

citations.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citations.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Dina tutors the arrogant first-year Maraff over tea and he suffers a spider charm.
timeline.quote: Approximately three and a half minutes later, Maraff was on the ground showing no signs of his earlier braggadocio.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina visits Deans Lisette and Valentin in their lab, where they work on a crucible.
timeline.quote: Dina entered the laboratory where the deans of Witherbloom College, Professors Lisette and Valentin, gazed into a crucible being heated by a floating blue flame.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina declines to attend the Prismari party and says she has work to do.
timeline.quote: I have work to do.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina goes to her secret workshop in a hollow tree deep in the bog.
timeline.quote: It had been one month since she'd first discovered this particular tree, one month since she'd started on her own secret project.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina recalls finding the tome in the Biblioplex, the meditations of a mage fascinated by life and death (flashback).
timeline.quote: Part manual, part journal, it captured the meditations of an unnamed mage fascinated by life, death, and the realms locked between them.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina finds an esis seedling in Professor Onyx's classroom and takes a root sliver for the ritual.
timeline.quote: Among them was a single seedling whose ghostly white leaves matched that of the esis tree.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina remembers the Brittleblight destroying her glade and killing its dryads (flashback).
timeline.quote: When the Brittleblight came for her glade, like it had done for many across Arcavios, few noticed its effects.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina recalls that Lisette rescued her from the dying glade (flashback).
timeline.quote: it was she who had arrived at Dina's glade to rescue her before the sickness could take a permanent hold

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina applies her poultice to the pests, asking them to take a short trip for her.
timeline.quote: I need you to take a short trip for me.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina traces spirals on the pests and begins reciting the ritual.
timeline.quote: She placed the spellbook on the ground, and on each pest, she traced a spiral

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's ink magic cuts a tree and interrupts her concentration.
timeline.quote: A snap broke her concentration.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Killian's wave of ink knocks Dina down before he helps her up.
timeline.quote: a wave of inky force was rolling toward Dina

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The corrupted ritual turns the pests into a quivering orb of ink magic, which sprouts tendrils into the ground.
timeline.quote: But instead of dead pests, sitting on the ground was a jet-black sphere of ink magic quivering as if alive.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina drags Killian away as the trees wail from the corrupted spell.
timeline.quote: she took the young man's wrist, pulled as hard as she could, and ran away from the site

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina recognizes Killian as Dean Lu's son and shows him the forbidden tome.
timeline.quote: Up close, Dina recognized the young man as the son of Dean Lu

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Returning, they find the pest den destroyed and the pests gone.
timeline.quote: There were no signs of the pests, and the only remnants of their den were splinters floating on the surface of the creek.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina and Killian bond over losing their mothers; Dina's glade is gone.
timeline.quote: My mother died when I was very young.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: They find a wounded vineclinger, and Killian saves Dina from its swipe with ink barbs.
timeline.quote: Acting quickly, Killian pulled her away with one arm

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina sees through the vineclinger's memories the new creature that fought and wounded it.
timeline.quote: It moved like a great wurm, gouging a path in the soft ground.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina deduces the creature is headed toward Sedgemoor and is just newly born.
timeline.quote: Toward Sedgemoor.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: They find the monster coiled around ancient trees, and Killian proposes breaking the ink-magic heart.
timeline.quote: If we could just access its heart again, we could break the spell

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina feeds Killian lionspaw leaves so he can see in the dark.
timeline.quote: Lionspaw has side effects on humans,

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina uses a balancing spell on the creature, making it brittle and slow at great cost to herself.
timeline.quote: Dina sunk her hand into the dirt a few steps away from the creature and began reciting one of the first spells she learned at Strixhaven.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina binds Killian with roots, then faces the creature as it crashes down on her.
timeline.quote: And then, like a great tidal wave, the creature crashed down upon her.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: In a vision of her glade, a dryad asks whether Dina's lost ones would want to be brought back.
timeline.quote: And how do you know that they want that?

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina touches the drop of her blood that bound the spell, breaking it.
timeline.quote: Dina focused on the single drop of her own blood that had bound the spell together.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina wakes in the Widdershins infirmary and learns Killian dragged her there.
timeline.quote: The boy is tenacious, dragging you all the way from the bog with a festering wound.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Valentin lets Dina stay at Strixhaven as a place of second chances.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven is a place for new beginnings.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina's glade falls victim to the Brittleblight, and even Dean Lisette cannot halt its devastation.
timeline.quote: her glade fell victim to the insidious spread of the Brittleblight

citation.text: "Dina", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a student Dina researches a forbidden resurrection spell and planar travel to find an Esis root to revive the glade.
timeline.quote: Dina wished to revive the glade and started to research a forbidden resurrection spell.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Student". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Killian's stray ink magic corrupts Dina's experiment, creating a living swamp monster; they defeat it, Killian is fatally injured, and Dina sacrifices the spell in her blood to cure him.
timeline.quote: Dina cured her newfound friend.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Student". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dina cures the Brittleblight later that year, though too late for her grove.
timeline.quote: Dina was able to cure the Brittleblight, although it was too late for her grove.

citation.text: "Dina", section "Student". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Killian's ink bolt disrupts Dina's resurrection spell, creating a swamp monster; they defeat it and Dina heals his fatal wound.
timeline.quote: Killian and Dina managed to defeat the monster

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko lures Sanar, Abigale, Kirol and Tamira through an Omenpath to Lorwyn-Shadowmoor while they collect flowers at Harrier's Wood.
timeline.quote: the faerie planeswalker Oko appeared and lured Sanar

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Killian meets Dina outside Bow's End, who is on a date with Vickus.
timeline.quote: It was his friend Dina, also a second-year.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Vickus, jealous of Killian and Dina, absorbs a pest's life force and challenges him.
timeline.quote: The pest gave a screech as its life force left and entered his host.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Students led by Dina blast the mage hunters to pieces.
timeline.quote: The final attack came from Dina, who hurled an enormous ball of pulsing beryl magic at the horrid creatures and shattered them into pieces.

citation.text: "A Silent Voice Calls" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: When the Phyrexians invade, Vess sends the surviving students to find the Invocation of the Founders in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Dina blend Quandrix mathematics and Witherbloom biology into new interdisciplinary magic against the invaders.
timeline.quote: they blended their magics and found to their delight

citation.text: "Dina", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students climb into the Biblioplex and find it overrun by red sinew and the Invasion Tree, with the invocation's motes fighting the gloom.
timeline.quote: His lovely, luminous center of learning was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students flee through the Biblioplex, fighting back with magic.
timeline.quote: They didn't even speak. They just ran.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students sneak through the Biblioplex avoiding patrolling professors, and Quint summons a statue spirit that shouts at a professor to save Zimone.
timeline.quote: No talking in the library!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find the Invocation of the Founders on a platform and discover it is partially alive and shields them from Phyrexian attention.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us from Phyrexian attention.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina and Zimone build a ritual to blast a hole to open air, while a professor attacks and the invocation folds into a pocket-sized ball.
timeline.quote: he grabbed it and rammed it into his pocket, out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The ritual's overload turns the Biblioplex's bookcases into a huge tree that smashes through the ceiling.
timeline.quote: and kept growing , boughs forming a perfect helix of steps

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Liliana finds Dina, Killian, Zimone and Rootha injured, and Killian digs out his father alive.
timeline.quote: but alive, and himself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Dina reports that Quint vanished in a burst of light, and Liliana wonders if he sparked.
timeline.quote: If Quint's spark ignited, he could still be alive

citation.work: March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Arcavios: A Radiant Heart" by Evelyn Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Invocation is activated; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away, but the attackers are repelled.
timeline.quote: Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Killian Lu", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace is dead.
timeline.quote: Ajani confirmed that he had witnessed the death of Jace

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Post-Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians burn through Strixhaven's defenses and Vess sends surviving students to find the Invocation.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians quickly burned through the defenses of Strixhaven

citation.text: "Rootha Squallheart", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Vess sends surviving students to activate the Invocation of the Founders; Quint's spark ignites and he planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: in the process, Quint's spark ignited, and he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zimone and Dina blend Quandrix and Witherbloom magic to fight, discovering new interdisciplinary magic.
timeline.quote: Zimone enhanced Dina's plant growth

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zimone models the Multiverse, concludes someone is copying it from Arcavios, and identifies Chandra Nalaar via a psychic-signature spell with Dina.
timeline.quote: Zimone concluded that someone was creating a parallel copy of the Multiverse, using Arcavios as a starting point.

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Postgrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dina announces the class has reached the Harrier's Wood for sample collection.
timeline.quote: We have reached the Harrier's Wood.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina shows the students a snarlflower and sets them to gather six to ten unblemished blossoms each.
timeline.quote: you are each expected to gather no fewer than six and no more than ten unblemished snarlflower blossoms

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina bursts in to report that four students are missing after following a flying creature down an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: We think they fell down an Omenpath, but it closed before we could go after them.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani offers to try to find the missing students and goes with Dina to the site.
timeline.quote: I can certainly try,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 2: Shake Off Slumber" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood to search for the four missing students.
timeline.quote: led the two out of the building where Liliana's office was located and across the fields toward the Harrier's Wood.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Liliana calls up black fog and concludes the students are not dead.
timeline.quote: Like Jace, they aren't dead,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani glows and vanishes to go after the students, and Liliana takes Dina back to campus.
timeline.quote: On the second step, he was gone.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Dina tries to calm the students at the camp as Sanar spots a green smoke signal from Lluwen.
timeline.quote: That's Lluwen's signal! It must be!

citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 3: Asunder" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Zimone panics when her flat grows warm and the window is found closed, then Dina knocks on the door.
timeline.quote: She half-gasps, half-sobs, and bruises her knuckles diving over the bed to open it again.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Zimone rants about Friend Zimone to Dina, who gently points out that the double is Zimone herself.
timeline.quote: "Hey. That's you."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Zimone realizes she cannot be everything, and decides to just be herself for a while.
timeline.quote: "I can't be everything. I think I need to just be me for a while."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Zimone shows Dina her model, and they trace the duplicate's caster by spell, which points to Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: "Oh, damn, she's famous," she says, pointing at the image. "Chandra Nalaar.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Zimone closes her window and agrees to take Dina's offer of a place to stay.
timeline.quote: She walks to the window and closes it.

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | The Math of More" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Dina's Witherbloom students examine a dead giant bird on the path while Basil does not want to watch.
timeline.quote: "Sampling the blood now," said Morphia

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Dina tells her students Mertyn's revenant will appear that night and not to go with him to the lake alone.
timeline.quote: "Don't go with him to the lake, alone."

citation.work: Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone
citation.text: "Secrets of Strixhaven | Down to the Lake, Alone" by Isaac Fellman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Mertyn's revenant knocks and Lorenin answers; Mertyn invites him to the lake, and Lorenin refuses and closes the door.
